notes.title: Important Bullet Heck Announcement
notes.content:
[i]To our lovely fan,[/i]
As you may be aware, I’m trying to make Bullet Heck the best game it could possibly be, and in its current state I don’t believe it meets that criteria. The game has undergone a saddening diagnosis known as [i]feature creep[/i]

Due to this, I feel the need to delay the release of the game until further notice. All I will say at this time is that I will be adding a singleplayer story campaign to the game. In the meantime, you can play Bullet Heck’s Steam Demo which has online multiplayer.
[i]Squaggies
Bullet Heck Lead[/i]
